home.llmP1: Industrial asset protection refers to the systematic engineering approach of identifying, measuring, and controlling contamination sources that degrade mechanical equipment. In industrial operations, contamination — including particles, water, heat, and chemical byproducts — is the primary driver of premature equipment failure across engines, hydraulic systems, fuel circuits, drivetrains, and cabin environments.
home.llmP2: Contamination accelerates wear at the microscopic level. Particles smaller than 10 microns cause abrasive wear on bearing surfaces, valve spools, and injector orifices — reducing component life by 30–50% when left uncontrolled. Water contamination in fuel systems promotes microbial growth, injector corrosion, and combustion instability. In hydraulic circuits, even minor contamination exceeding ISO cleanliness targets disrupts valve response, accelerates seal degradation, and increases system failure risk.
home.llmP3: Industrial asset protection is not a product category. It is a contamination control strategy that begins with understanding the contamination targets for each system, selecting engineered technologies capable of meeting those targets, and monitoring system performance throughout the equipment lifecycle.
home.llmP4: The result: longer equipment life, fewer unplanned failures, lower maintenance costs, and higher operational availability — measured not in filters replaced, but in assets protected.
home.faqTitle: Common Questions About Industrial Asset Protection

faqItems.q: What does industrial asset protection mean?
faqItems.a: Industrial asset protection is the systematic control of contamination across all critical mechanical systems — air intake, fuel, hydraulic, lube, and cooling — to prevent premature equipment failure. ELIMFILTERS® engineers contamination control systems that extend asset life, reduce unplanned downtime, and lower total cost of ownership.

faqItems.q: How does contamination cause equipment failure?
faqItems.a: Contamination particles wear bearing surfaces, restrict fuel injectors, and degrade seal integrity. Particles smaller than 10 microns cause abrasive wear invisible to the naked eye. Uncontrolled contamination reduces engine bearing life from 15,000+ hours to 2,000–3,000 hours. Water in fuel promotes microbial growth and injector corrosion.

faqItems.q: What ISO cleanliness code should a hydraulic system target?
faqItems.a: Most industrial hydraulic systems require ISO 17/15/12 cleanliness to protect proportional valve spools. Critical systems may specify ISO 15/13/10. ELIMFILTERS® contamination control strategies target measured cleanliness codes — the ISO 4406 standard — not product brands.

faqItems.q: Why is ELIMFILTERS not a filter company?
faqItems.a: ELIMFILTERS engineers contamination control systems, not commodity filters. A filter is a component. An asset protection system is a strategy — it defines contamination targets, selects the right technologies for each system domain, and measures performance over the equipment lifecycle. ELIMFILTERS operates at the system level.

about.heroLead: ELIMFILTERS® is Kleo Technology LLC's global industrial filtration brand. We develop advanced contamination-control technologies to reduce wear, prevent avoidable failure, extend equipment life, and protect the economic value of severe-duty machinery. ELIMFILTERS products are available exclusively through authorized distributors.
about.section1Title: A global brand built around equipment reliability.
about.section1Lead: ELIMFILTERS® was created from direct experience with industrial filtration, equipment maintenance, distribution, and the operational consequences of contamination. Owned by Kleo Technology LLC, ELIMFILTERS operates globally through a curated network of authorized distributors, ensuring that advanced filtration technology reaches critical industrial applications worldwide.
about.section1Body: Our role is to connect product engineering, contamination intelligence, technical standards, cross-reference data, application knowledge, and field evidence into a system that helps our distribution partners, fleets, maintenance teams, and industrial operators make better protection decisions. We do not sell directly to end users; we work exclusively through authorized distributors who bring ELIMFILTERS technologies to market with the technical expertise and customer relationships required for severe-duty applications.
about.section2Title: Reduce the distance between contamination and failure.
about.section2Lead: Contamination becomes expensive long before a machine stops. It changes clearances, damages surfaces, destabilizes pressure, degrades fluids, reduces efficiency, and shortens component life. Our objective is to identify that risk early and engineer protection before the damage becomes operational.
about.section3Title: Mathematical modeling. AI-assisted simulation. Field validation.
about.section3Body: ELIMFILTERS® technologies are not created as marketing labels. Each one represents an engineering architecture derived from the behavior of contamination inside a specific protection domain. Mathematical analysis and AI-assisted simulation help us evaluate variables that cannot be understood from a part number alone, while controlled testing and field validation confirm whether the design performs under real operating conditions.
about.engineeringMethod01Body: We begin with the machine, its operating environment, duty cycle, fluid system, contamination exposure, component tolerances, and failure consequences.
about.engineeringMethod02Body: Mathematical models and AI-assisted simulations are used to analyze particle behavior, flow conditions, pressure changes, thermal cycles, and expected contaminant loading.
about.engineeringMethod03Body: Media, geometry, sealing, structural materials, pressure response, and service requirements are defined as one integrated protection system rather than isolated product features.
about.engineeringMethod04Body: A technology is not considered complete at the simulation stage. Production designs must be confirmed through controlled testing and field validation before they become part of the ELIMFILTERS® platform.
about.section4Title: Engineering decisions must protect real operating value.
about.principle01Title: Protect the asset, not the replacement part
about.principle01Body: The value of filtration is measured by the component damage, downtime, labor, production loss, and asset-life reduction it prevents.
about.principle02Body: We study how contamination reaches critical clearances and how wear develops before deciding what protection architecture the system requires.
about.principle03Body: Laboratory data establishes control. Field validation establishes relevance. Both are required to support a severe-duty industrial application.
about.closingTitle: We do not begin with a filter. We begin with the asset that cannot afford to fail.
about.closingDesc: The result is a growing industrial protection platform designed to turn engineering knowledge, validated technology, and product intelligence into measurable reliability support.
